items.title: Sherwood Mangiapane Interview, 1959-05-05
items.q: I was playing with Classy when he loaned me that bass, and I started to play the thing in his band.

ctx.x: And when you took up your string bass, which band did you belong to first?
Classy. Same thing? I was playing with Classy when he loaned me that bass, and I started to play the thing in his band.
Do you remember some of the jobs you played in different places, aside from parties?
